# KuCoin REST fixtures

Captured 2026-11-15 from the first poller records on `root@64.118.133.169` under `/root/ps/data/raw/kucoin/`; files contain their unmodified `p` payloads. `contracts.json` is the complete bulk response; `riskLimit.json` is XBTUSDTM. The risk-limit endpoint covers isolated margin only.
